decisive_spans.text: Lesion located in dorsolateral right pons

response.rationale: D3 (Pontine glioma) is supported by the presence of a lesion in the dorsolateral right pons. D4 (Brainstem stroke) is also supported by the lesion location and symptoms, but it has a contradiction regarding the absence of vertebrobasilar artery occlusion, which is a common cause of stroke. D2 (Multiple sclerosis) has a contradiction regarding the absence of facial pain and temperature sensation impairment, which is not explicitly contradicted for D3. D5 (Stroke) has the same contradiction as D4. Given the information, Pontine glioma is a strong candidate, and the lack of vertebrobasilar artery occlusion makes stroke less likely.
